text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model that can make predictions about new information. For example, a model can learn to identify spam emails after studying many examples. The quality of the training data is very important, because it affects the model’s accuracy. If the data is clear and complete, the model usually makes better predictions. Machine learning is now used in many areas, such as medicine, finance, and technology.
